donor_domain: condensed-matter physics (Landau theory); fitness-landscape genetics (neutral networks)
donor_source_ids: Landau theory of phase transitions (standard textbook form); Maynard Smith 1970; Schuster et al. 1994 RNA neutral networks (survey-level, L2)
donor_structure: Mexican-hat potential: the set of minimizing configurations is a continuous manifold (a G-orbit under the symmetry group); every point of the manifold is an exact global optimum; neutral directions = tangent to the manifold. Neutral-network analogue: connected components of genotype space at equal fitness; neutral moves walk the component without fitness change.
target_structure: optimizer neutral sets: the set argmin B of admissible states/strategies tied on burden; optimizer moves that keep burden exactly constant are 'neutral moves'; the question is whether neutral sets are traversable (connected) and what geometry they induce on the search state.
mapping: potential B -> burden functional; degenerate minimum manifold -> argmin B; symmetry group action -> burden-invariant transformations (e.g. program rewrites preserving I/O semantics); order parameter -> coarse coordinate transverse to the neutral manifold; neutral drift on the component -> burden-neutral optimizer walk.
preserved_relations: invariance: B is constant on the neutral set (exact analogue of potential constant on the G-orbit)
cost-free local motion inside the neutral set (no first-order burden gradient along tangent/neutral directions)
broken-symmetry reading: choosing one optimizer = selecting a point on the manifold; the choice is not determined by B
known_broken_relations: continuity: Landau manifolds are continuous; program/strategy neutral sets are discrete (graph components), so tangent-space language is only an analogy - the correct object is a neutral-move graph

transitivity of neutrality: composition of two burden-neutral moves need not be burden-neutral off a group orbit (burden plateaus are not closed under composition unless neutrality comes from an actual symmetry group); breaks Landau-style manifold closure
genericity: Landau degeneracy is generic at a phase boundary; optimizer degeneracy is contingent on the price vector (vii), not on a universal symmetry
unknown_correspondences: whether HSG burden plateaus carry any approximate group structure (near-symmetry quantification) is unmeasured
whether neutral-set connectivity correlates with long-run evolvability in the HSG process (GP-map literature says yes in biology; HSG analogue unstudied)
assumptions_added: burden functional B plays the role of a potential (real-valued, defined on all states)
neutral move set fixed per constitution (frozen price vector vii) during a neutral walk
candidate_theorem: Optimizer neutral sets are connected under elementary neutral moves iff neutrality is generated by a burden-invariant transformation group (orbit closure); for mere plateaus (neutral pairwise but not jointly), connectivity can fail - the Landau picture holds exactly only in the symmetry case.
strongest_parent: Landau theory degeneracy structure (textbook standard; no single canonical citation - treated as standard form) + neutral-network connectivity (Maynard Smith 1970 class)
route: L2 structural reading + map/synth/validate; validation by attempted counterexample against transitivity (burden plateau not closed under composed neutral moves - succeeds, forcing the conditional form)
status_rationale: structural mapping solid and generative, but the manifold/orbit closure claim fails for non-group plateaus; receipt carries the corrected conditional statement. Calibration donor (not evidence) per freeze.
